descriptionText:
This Bryce Young 2023 Score Rookie Card RC #301 from the Carolina Panthers is a must-have for any football enthusiast. The card features a stunning design and showcases the player's talent in a unique way. It is perfect for collectors and fans alike, and is sure to be a cherished addition to any collection.

With its impressive set of features, including a score parallel/variety and a rookie designation, this card is a true standout. The card is produced by Panini, a well-known manufacturer of sports trading cards, and it is part of the 2023 Score set. The card is not autographed, but it is still an amazing addition to any collection.
